keyconfounds: Named N357548/376-segment fixture exercises all13 bins, all32 source entry kernels and max5000 long merge; original 2^25 throughput scale not measured.
Source timed counter readback controls dependent host launch sizes; whole region is mixed host/device, not kernel-only or pure frontend causality.
Pair keys unique within each segment make unstable source tie handling unambiguous; general pair duplicate-key tie order remains unverified. Key-only duplicate/negative values tested.
Valid keys exclude Int32MAX padding sentinel; initialized Julia dummy registers define otherwise uninitialized source padding payload, not a proof for sentinel-valued inputs.
Raw internal atomic bin-ID order retained as diagnostic and checked for bin membership/full permutation; it is not public sorted output or canonicalized output evidence.
Mechanically generated source bytes are not billed translation tokens; shared parser/body generation and reference repairs separately costed.

scientific_intent.community_use: Ordering primitive for irregular analytics and segmented sparse/data structures; benchmark does not supply an application-level quality criterion.
